metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude skills and plugins

plugins.name: skill-collection
plugins.description: All skills in skills/ bundled as one plugin

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Memory that persists project and file context across sessions (thedotmack/claude-mem)

plugins.name: astryx
plugins.description: Astryx design system: guides the agent to build UI from templates via the astryx CLI (meta/astryx)

plugins.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
plugins.description: Chrome DevTools for agents: run, screenshot, debug and profile pages in a real browser (ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp)

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend work: one skill with 24 design commands (polish, audit, critique) plus anti-pattern detection (pbakaus/impeccable)

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Design skill that avoids template-looking AI output; optional image generation via Together AI (Nutlope/hallmark)

plugins.name: plannotator
plugins.description: Annotate and review plans and documents in a browser UI and send feedback back to the agent; needs the plannotator binary (backnotprop/plannotator)

plugins.name: stitch-design
plugins.description: Google Stitch design workflows: generate screens, code-to-design, design systems, extract HTML (needs the Stitch MCP server and API key)

plugins.name: stitch-utilities
plugins.description: Google Stitch helpers: DESIGN.md specs, prompt enhancement, stitch-loop site building (needs the Stitch MCP server for most skills)
